title: Deliver child output through the physical continuation boundary
body:
This closes the designated output-return boundary left by [PR #5329](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5329) and [PR #5356](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5356). One reusable relay tape preserves a binary child result through child cleanup and physical pop, installs it in a reserved empty parent role, and returns empty. All other parent payloads, heads, presence bits and descriptors return exactly. Nineteen tapes suffice for every finite properly nested successful call tree.

The [proof and exact invoice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1362d9350b733af1c8a8822e0a013c1ff7de64dc/research/continuation-output-return/PROOF.md), [return routine](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1362d9350b733af1c8a8822e0a013c1ff7de64dc/research/continuation-output-return/return_output.py), [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1362d9350b733af1c8a8822e0a013c1ff7de64dc/research/continuation-output-return/RESULT.json) and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1362d9350b733af1c8a8822e0a013c1ff7de64dc/research/continuation-output-return/SOURCES.json) define the scope. The complete matched push/return bill is `13Hp+4Sp+38k+18d+5q+2A+2Hc+5W+17L+61` reads, writes and unit moves. The variables and input ABI are defined in the proof. This includes both output copies, all child cleanup, physical frame cleanup, descriptor return and relay cleanup. It excludes child computation and input/descriptor production. It has no ancestor-length or depth factor. Relay backing and the parent output are charged explicitly.

The complete kappa calculation is unchanged. The parent must reserve an occupied empty output role. The byte-exact [retained stack](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ef1cc26e1e9a08c11cf382de948ee433bebab16d/research/delimited-continuation-stack/stack.py) is from pending PR #5356 and remains an explicit predecessor premise. This does not implement packet reorder, recursive C, source counter/slot compilation, production descriptor delivery, complete supplier stock/precision or outer recovery. The actual-source calibration retains its Python allocation facade. Failed ABI calls need not restore partially changed state.

Validation on CPython 3.12.13, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/continuation-output-return
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/continuation-output-return
```

Both registered isolated, warning-strict normal and optimized commands pass `PASS_CONTINUATION_OUTPUT_RETURN`. There are 1800 exact invoice cases, twelve nested cases through depth 31, six unchanged compact-source cases in both layouts, and six rejecting ABI controls. The source returns deliver all 1024 bits of an independently checked 128-record permutation. Each return costs 24388 tape actions at ancestor lengths 16,257,4096. Four disposable code mutations reject in both modes before receipt comparison. Committed-byte checks, official export integrity and both read-only Git-free export commands pass; all 16 exported files remain unchanged.

Base is canonical main `7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56`, priority 7, refreshed before submission. Base-source ancestry is on main; the explicitly pinned pending stack head is not claimed as merged. The full-history wrapper, selected cold replay, full production rectangle, native compiler, Lean and Docker were not run. Hosted CI and independent human/proof-kernel acceptance remain separate.

Overlap includes the live continuation Discussion, targeted all-state output-return PR search, refreshed public PR/Discussion bodies and a supplementary canonical-main README search. The sparse checkout does not contain all notes; arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain unsearched. This PR adds only this package. The live stack scope was already complete, so the contribution takes its separate output-delivery handoff.

Credit @aliromman for the retained physical stack; @JoyboyBrian for the segment refinement and [PR #5041](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5041) locality invoice; @jmbarrancoml for the sequential compact primitives in [PR #2250](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2250); Douglas Colkitt for guard/repair; Cinna Davis for the caller; and @Matarener for cover/stock work. Their retained roles and notices are in the [pinned source package](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56/research/complex-segment-boundary/README.md). New work: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, implementation, review and verification. Apache-2.0.
